# Standard Roofing Company

> Residential, commercial, and specialty roofing contractor based in Loveland, Colorado. Serves Northern Colorado (Larimer, Weld, and Boulder counties) and the mountain communities. Phone (970) 430-5884.

## Specialty roofing

- [Specialty roofing overview](https://standardroofingcompany.net/specialty-roofing.html)
- [Metal Roofing](https://standardroofingcompany.net/metal-roofing.html): Standing seam, metal shingle, and stone-coated steel roofing for Northern Colorado and the mountains. Class 4 hail ratings, snow retention, and 40+ year service life. Free inspections.
- [Slate Roofing](https://standardroofingcompany.net/slate-roofing.html): Natural slate roofing installation, repair, and restoration in Loveland, Fort Collins, Boulder County, and the mountain towns. Structural evaluation, copper flashing, and lifetime roofs done right.
- [Tile Roofing](https://standardroofingcompany.net/tile-roofing.html): Concrete and clay tile roof installation, repair, and underlayment replacement in Loveland, Fort Collins, Windsor, and Northern Colorado. Freeze-thaw rated tile, proper underlayment, and tile lift and relay.
- [Cedar Shake Roofing](https://standardroofingcompany.net/cedar-shake-roofing.html): Cedar shake and shingle roofing, repair, and replacement in Northern Colorado and the mountains. Fire-treated Class A assemblies, wildfire code guidance, and synthetic shake alternatives where cedar is no longer allowed.
- [Synthetic Roofing](https://standardroofingcompany.net/synthetic-roofing.html): Composite synthetic slate and shake roofing in Loveland, Fort Collins, and Northern Colorado. Class 4 impact rated, Class A fire rated, lightweight, 50-year warranties. The hail-proof way to get the slate or cedar look.
- [Roof Coatings](https://standardroofingcompany.net/roof-coatings.html): Silicone, acrylic, and urethane roof coating systems for flat and low-slope commercial roofs in Loveland, Fort Collins, Greeley, and Northern Colorado. Restore TPO, EPDM, mod bit, and metal roofs instead of replacing them.

## Facts

- Colorado law prohibits roofing contractors from paying, waiving, or rebating insurance deductibles. Standard Roofing Company never does.
- Fort Collins requires UL 2218 Class 4 impact-resistant asphalt shingles (since January 2019) and a waste management plan on every roofing permit.
- Larimer County requires Class A roof coverings countywide and Class 4 asphalt shingles on new and replacement roofs, with an ice barrier and roofing certification.
- Colorado's Wildfire Resiliency Code requires Class A roof coverings in designated wildland-urban interface zones; local enforcement began July 2026.
